description: AI-authored Kotlin/Wasm harness compiled against the human-authored kotlin-codepoints 0.11.0 Unicode code point library, exercising supplementary-plane iteration, indexing, construction, mutation, and invalid surrogate handling.
notes: Built as an optimized Kotlin/Wasm WASI library fixture. The exported score functions intentionally fold richer library results into i32 values so the corpus runner can assert behavior without requiring string return support.
